query:
SELECT d.id
        FROM "Document" d
        WHERE d."fileType" = 'md'
          AND d."deletedAt" IS NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM document_sub_type dst
              WHERE dst.document_id = d.id
          )
          AND (
              $1
              OR NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM document_similarity_embedding dse
                  WHERE dse.document_id = d.id
              )
          )
        LIMIT $2
